verdict.rationale: Zep's docs say graph search combines semantic similarity with BM25 full-text search, so retrieval is hybrid rather than a single fixed vector search. A scope parameter (e.g. scope="auto") lets developers steer which graph elements are searched, and Graphiti also documents hybrid retrieval. However, the evidence shows no metadata filters, no reranker options, and no way to pick keyword-only versus semantic-only modes. Missing for 10: documented metadata/attribute filters, reranking options, selectable search modes, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can steer retrieval with metadata filters, keyword/hybrid search modes, or reranking instead of accepting a single fixed similarity search

citations.quote: Zep graph search combines semantic similarity with BM25 full-text search. Semantic search finds conceptual matches, and full-text search finds exact terms.
set scope="auto" and let Zep dynamically compose the most relevant context across edges, nodes, episodes, observations, and thread summaries into a single ready-to-use block.
entity and edge extraction, the bi-temporal model, fact invalidation, and hybrid retrieval.
